occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Through observations and interviews it was determined that the classroom was not properly maintained by having a broken window which was accessible by children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: This standard was evaluated as the result of an A/N investigation and was found to be deficient.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of caregivers-Set appropriate behavior expectations: This standard was evaluated as the result of an A/N investigation and was found to be deficient.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities (26 TAC §746.1203(6))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: This standard was evaluated as the result of an A/N investigation and was found to be deficient.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The provider did not report the number of employees who left in 2024 in the required time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant: It was observed that all four cribs in the infant 1 room was not label with child's name.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records: The person in charge states she doesn't have access to the personnel record while the director as away from the center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: It was observed that the paint on the wall and wooden base around the room in the nfant 2 class are tripping off.  It was also observed that the two carpets in the infant 1 room had white particles on it that children may pick up and put it in their mouth.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: It was observed an iphone charger with cord laying on the floor in the infant one room that accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area - Crib Placement: It was observed that all four cribs are together touching each other.  One crib was blocked in the corner by other two cribs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area - Crib Placement (26 TAC §746.2403(4))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Changing Address or Location: The operation moved to a temporary relocation without obtaining approval from CCR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Changing Address or Location (26 TAC §746.301(1))

occurrences.finding: HRC 42.04271 - Parent's Rights: Children's files are missing the required parents rights forms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: HRC 42.04271 - Parent's Rights (26 TAC §HRC 42.04271 - Parent's Rights)

occurrences.finding: Provide care consistent with child's habits, interests, strengths, special needs, including any special supervision needs: The classroom was seen to be out of control and with multiple concerns while the caregiver was not adequately supervising the group or keeping the children engaged.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver in the infant classroom had a pending background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: The incident report was not signed within 48 hours following the incident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Determining Child/Caregiver Ratios - Basis: It was observed 18 children with one caregiver in a group that the  Specific Age Group was 3 years old, the number of children should be 15 children to one caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Determining Child/Caregiver Ratios - Basis (26 TAC §746.1507(1))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operation is short staff, as a result ratios and caregivers responsibilities has been cited in the last visits.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Exceeding Maximum Group Size - 18 Mons - 4 Years (30 mins): Infants under the age of 17 months old were combined with children older than 18 months old during nap time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Exceeding Maximum Group Size - 18 Mons - 4 Years (30 mins) (26 TAC §746.1611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was left unsupervised in the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver did not follow the procedures during a transition, as a result a child was left unsupervised in the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety: A caregiver did not ensure the safety of the child under the age of 2 years old. The child was left unsupervised in the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene to ensure each child's safety (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: It was determined that the director did not ensure all employees complied with minimum standard requirements related to the reporting of suspected abuse/neglect of a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers-Report Suspected Child Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation: It was determined that a caregiver did not appropriately report suspected abuse of a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers-Report Suspected Child Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation (26 TAC §746.1201(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: It was determined that a caregiver did not demonstrate good judgement in the interaction with children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver did not demonstrate self-control in the discipline of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: Video evidence confirmed that a caregiver used prohibited punishment in the discipline of a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of caregivers-Set appropriate behavior expectations: Based on video evidence, behavior expectations enforced by caregivers exceeded what would be the appropriate behavior for the child's current stage of development. Children were observed in the classroom engaging in typical behavior for their age/development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities (26 TAC §746.1203(6))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing: A caregiver's CPR/FA training had expired in October 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Water Activity Permission: A child's file was missing water activity permission.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Six children's files were missing statements from their healthcare professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Transportation Permission: A child's file was missing transportation permissions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Transportation Permission (26 TAC §746.605(8))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: A child that is not yet on table foods did not have current feeding instructions on file. The last update was from September 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: Three caregivers had expired infant-related trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Five children's files were missing addresses for their emergency contacts.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))
